primary_sources.role: species traits, Mb concentration and net charge data, ancestral inference

published_findings_to_test.finding: Maximal Mb net surface charge (ZMb) increased along lineages evolving high Mb concentration; ZMb rises from about +1 to +7 in deep divers.
published_findings_to_test.test: Do epistaeon's detected sites for MB concentrate on surface, charge-changing positions in 1MBO?

published_findings_to_test.finding: Increased net positive charge is proposed to prevent aggregation at high Mb concentration.
published_findings_to_test.test: Structural, not evolutionary: are the detected sites solvent-exposed rather than buried?

published_findings_to_test.finding: The white paper asserts internal B/E-helix packing substitutions preceded surface charge accumulation.
published_findings_to_test.test: Flag as a white paper claim without a published source. Treat as unverified unless located in Mirceta.

structures.notes: Sperm whale, the target taxon. 1.6 A, complete, haem plus bound O2.

known_limitations: Mirceta crystallised no ancestral myoglobins, so 1MBO can only serve as a geometric scaffold.
No measured recombinant ancestral mutation panel; the supplement gives inferred ancestral states and trait data.
Ordering claims (MB3) have no experimental ground truth at all.
expected_outcome_note: Species coverage is good here (sperm whale, elephant seal, Weddell seal all present), so MB1 and MB2 are genuinely testable. MB3 is not.
